excerpt: Whenever I used to hear about mooli ka Raita (radish dip) I used to turn up my nose and look away. I…

recipe.name: Mooli ka Raita
recipe.summary: I had no idea what I was missing out on.
recipe.summary_plain: I had no idea what I was missing out on.

items.name: chaat masala
items.notes: use less if you’re using store bought
items.text: 1.5 tsp chaat masala, use less if you’re using store bought

items.name: red chili powder
items.text: 1 tsp red chili powder, or to taste

items.name: small bunch of finely chopped cilantro
items.text: 1 small bunch of finely chopped cilantro

steps.text: Peel your radish and chop it
steps.text_plain: Peel your radish and chop it

steps.text: Place it in the food processor and process till fine
steps.text_plain: Place it in the food processor and process till fine

steps.text: Get a large bowl and fill it half full with water and 2 tsp of salt
steps.text_plain: Get a large bowl and fill it half full with water and 2 tsp of salt

steps.text: Put your shredded radish in there and let it soak for about 30 minutes
steps.text_plain: Put your shredded radish in there and let it soak for about 30 minutes

steps.text: Rinse it in clean water and squeeze out all the water then place it on a paper towel and let any extra moisture get soaked onto the towel
steps.text_plain: Rinse it in clean water and squeeze out all the water then place it on a paper towel and let any extra moisture get soaked onto the towel

steps.text: Add all the spices and mix well.
steps.text_plain: Add all the spices and mix well.

steps.text: Taste it and adjust your spices accordingly
steps.text_plain: Taste it and adjust your spices accordingly

steps.text: Fold in the cilantro and green chilies and finally the radish
steps.text_plain: Fold in the cilantro and green chilies and finally the radish
